title: Eight Sleep media slot
description: A frame for a photo or video that fills its box like object-fit: cover. Empty, it is a plain token-coloured placeholder: a muted surface, a soft glow-to-pale sky, a black-to-navy night, or a faint surface on dark.
notes: the parent sets size, aspect ratio and radius; the slot fills it
